segments.name: Personal care and home fragrance
segments.description: Sells body care, home fragrance, soap and sanitizer products to consumers through company-operated stores, e-commerce, Amazon and international partner-operated locations.
segments.evidence: Bath & Body Works is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance, driven by the belief that everybody deserves to feel good.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay the company for body care and home fragrance products sold through its own stores, e-commerce sites, Amazon, and franchise, license and wholesale arrangements with international partners.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to our Company-operated stores, our products are sold at partner-operated locations and e-commerce sites in more than 45 countries through franchise, license and wholesale arrangements.
